description: TIMED texture of EVENT-GROUPS: texture grouped's random bursts (gpsizelo-gpsizehi events, gppacklo-gppackhi ms apart, spanning gpranglo-gpranghi semitones) hung on a COMPOSED timing cell instead of a stochastic packing grid. The notedata file carries line 1 = assumed MIDI pitch, then EXACTLY ONE '#N' timing block (rows 'time infile_no pitch amp dur'; zero/extra blocks refuse 'Incorrect number [N] of motifs in notedata file (expected 1).' - timed-family rule); the cell restarts every last-onset + skip seconds (timed-family cycling, content-verified on the timed sibling). Pinned to submode 5 (NONE - free pitch; modes 1-4 = harmonic fields). Genuinely stochastic with a WORKING -r seed (-r5 twice 1.2 s apart byte-identical; -r9 differs). Duration honesty: outdur 5 -> 6.39 (+28%), outdur 8 -> 9.22 (+15%) - last cell plus group tails extend past the grid; keep gpsizehi x gppackhi and maxdur small relative to outdur (grouped-family warning: huge groups inflate the render massively). Breakpoints: outdur/gpspace/contour/seed refuse (parameters 1/14/17/30 verbatim); ALL 17 other numeric positionals plus -a/-p/-s accept (full per-parameter sweep; skip additionally VERIFIED against both scalar endpoints at seed 5; gpsizehi brk re-verified). Mono input only ('Application doesn't work with this type of infile.'); output always STEREO; flag order enforced (family).
musical_use: Rhythmically-placed flurries: each hit of your composed cell fires a burst - grace-note clusters on the downbeats, granular swells in a fixed groove, antiphonal splashes locked to a limping ostinato. The cell gives placement discipline that plain grouped's packing knob cannot; the group engine keeps every burst's interior alive (count, speed, pitch-roam and contour re-diced per statement). gpsizelo/hi x gppacklo/hi set burst character (2-5 events at 20-90 ms = ornamental flicks; 10+ at short packs = granular puffs); gpranglo/hi how far each burst roams from its start pitch; amprise/contour its dynamic arc. skip breakpoints accelerate or relax the groove across the piece; gpsize breakpoints grow the bursts from single grace notes to avalanches. Siblings: timed (single events on the cell), tmotifs (written motifs on the cell), grouped (bursts on a stochastic grid). Always seed to pin a take.

notedata.description: REQUIRED text file (write_data_file()): line 1 = assumed MIDI pitch of the input; then EXACTLY ONE '#N' timing block of rows 'time infile_no pitch amp dur' (the rhythmic cell; timed-family refusals verbatim for zero/extra blocks). Resolved against the session's data/ directory.

outdur.description: Requested (minimum) duration; ran +28% (outdur 5) to +15% (outdur 8) over on the probe with small groups. Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 1').

skip.description: Gap between statements of the timing cell (period = last cell onset + skip). Breakpoint-capable and VERIFIED: a 0.8->2.0 brk at seed 5 differs from both scalar-endpoint renders. Keep positive (family skiptime-0 caution).

sndfirst.description: First sound from the input list (must be 1 here). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

sndlast.description: Last sound from the input list (must be 1 here). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

mindur.description: Minimum event duration (family floor 0.016). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

maxdur.description: Maximum event duration (>= mindur; contributes to the overshoot; far-beyond-input values fail obscurely - family finding). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

minpitch.description: Minimum pitch at which a group may start (MIDI). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

maxpitch.description: Maximum pitch at which a group may start (MIDI). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

phgrid.description: Timegrid in ms WITHIN groups (0 = none). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

gpspace.description: Spatialisation of event-groups 0-5 (family values). Breakpoint REFUSED ('Cannot read parameter 14') - family manual divergence.

gpsprange.description: Spatial range of event-groups 0-1. Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

amprise.description: Amplitude change within each group 0-127 (default 0 = flat). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

contour.description: Amplitude contour of groups 0-6 (grouped-family set). Breakpoint REFUSED ('Cannot read parameter 17').

gpsizelo.description: Smallest number of events in any group. Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

gpsizehi.description: Largest number of events in any group - grouped-family warning: large values inflate the render far past outdur. Breakpoint accepted (verified with a 2->8 ramp).

gppacklo.description: Shortest time between event onsets within a group, ms (family floor = one sample period, srate-dependent). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

gppackhi.description: Longest time between event onsets within a group, ms. Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

gpranglo.description: Minimum pitch range of group events in semitones (mode 5; hfield-note counts in modes 1-4). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

gpranghi.description: Maximum pitch range of group events in semitones. Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

atten.description: Overall attenuation multiplier (family range). Breakpoint accepted. Flag order enforced: -a -p -s -r then switches.

position.description: Centre of the stereo image 0-1 (family-enforced). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

spread.description: Spatial spread of texture events 0-1. Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

seed.description: Random seed - WORKING (-r5 pair byte-identical; -r9 differs). 0/omission = clock. Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 30').

whole.description: Play the whole input per event, ignoring mindur/maxdur (verified: changes render).

fixstep.description: Fixed timestep between group notes instead of random gppacklo-gppackhi (verified: changes render and length).

instrvary.description: Groups not confined to a fixed instrument - multi-input only (verified byte-identical no-op on this single-input entry).

examples.description: Grace-note flurries on a two-hit cell: 2-5 events per burst, roaming up to a fifth.

examples.description: Bursts growing from grace notes to avalanches via a gpsizehi breakpoint, crescendo contours.

known_issues: Duration honesty (set_by outdur): +28% at outdur 5, +15% at outdur 8 on the 0.5 s-ping probe with small groups; large gpsizehi x gppackhi inflates far more (grouped-family: 5 s -> 58.8 s observed with 1001-event groups). Duration row pinned at outdur 8, tol 0.3, seed 5.
Notedata: EXACTLY ONE timing block after the pitch line (timed-family refusals verbatim). Cell cycling: period = last cell onset + skip (content-verified on the timed sibling).

Breakpoint surface: outdur/gpspace/contour/seed refuse (parameters 1/14/17/30 verbatim - same gpspace/contour manual divergence as texture grouped); all 17 other numeric positionals plus -a/-p/-s accept (full sweep; skip verified against both endpoints at seed 5).
Mono input only ('Application doesn't work with this type of infile.'); output always STEREO; flag order enforced; working -r seed.
-i is a single-input no-op (verified byte-identical); goes live with multiple inputs via execute(). Modes 1-4 (harmonic fields) remain execute()-only.
gppacklo/gppackhi floor is one sample period (0.022676 ms at 44.1 kHz, srate-dependent) - grouped-family finding.
